steps.description: Extract: - product name; - project code, if any; - system type; - segment; - target audience; - main problem; - value proposition; - strategic vision; - updated hypotheses; - consolidated risks; - opportunities; - preliminary domains; - candidate modules; - candidate features; - main flows; - product principles; - Stage 3 recommendations; - official aesthetic direction from `0-estetica-inicial.md`. ---

steps.title: 2. Generate an executive summary of the specification
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '2. Generate an executive summary of the specification'.
steps.description: Create a clear summary containing: - what will be specified; - considered functional scope; - main assumptions; - decisions already made; - documentation limitations; - relationship to previous stages; - relationship to next stages; - specification maturity level. ---

steps.title: 3. Define the product’s functional structure
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '3. Define the product’s functional structure'.
steps.description: Organize the system into: - domains; - modules; - features; - screens; - actions; - events; - rules; - permissions; - states; - data; - integrations; - automations; - settings. Use a product, business, and operations-oriented approach. ---

steps.title: 4. Map functional domains
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '4. Map functional domains'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Domain description | Domain goal | Involved profiles | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| Consider, when applicable: - Platform; - Super-admin; - Backoffice; - Customer; - Operations; - Administration; - Data and Analytics; - AI and Automation; - Integrations; - Billing; - Security; - Settings; - Support; - Audit; - Tenant; - Company; - HQ; - Branch; - Public Portal; - End User Area. ---

steps.title: 5. Map modules by domain
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '5. Map modules by domain'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Module description | Module goal | Involved profiles | Priority | Origin | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| The `Origin` column must indicate whether the module came from: - Stage 1; - Stage 0; - Stage 2; - Stage 3; - Benchmarking; - Inference; - Best practice; - SaaS requirement; - Hypothesis. ---

steps.title: 6. Map features by module
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '6. Map features by module'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Feature | Feature description | Feature goal | User value | Priority | Origin | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| The features must cover the full product vision, not only the MVP. Include, when applicable: - main CRUDs; - operational flows; - base registrations; - dashboards; - reports; - notifications; - imports; - exports; - approvals; - audit; - integrations; - settings; - permissions; - onboarding; - billing; - support; - AI and automations. ---

steps.title: 7. Map screens by feature
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '7. Map screens by feature'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Feature | Screen | Screen description | Screen goal | Screen actions and events | Screen states | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider screens such as: - list; - details; - create; - edit; - delete; - confirmation; - approval; - settings; - history; - dashboard; - report; - import; - export; - onboarding; - error; - no permission; - empty; - loading. ---

steps.title: 8. Detail actions and events
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '8. Detail actions and events'.
steps.description: Required table: | Screen | Action or event | Type | Trigger | Expected result | Validation | User feedback | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested types: - click; - form submission; - selection; - filter; - search; - sort; - upload; - download; - approval; - rejection; - confirmation; - cancelation; - automation; - notification; - integration; - error. ---

steps.title: 9. Map initial business rules
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '9. Map initial business rules'.
steps.description: Required table: | ID | Business rule | Description | Domain | Module | Feature | Impact | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include rules related to: - validation; - permissions; - statuses; - approvals; - plan limits; - multi-tenant; - multi-company; - HQ/branch; - billing; - notifications; - audit; - deadlines; - integrations; - AI; - security; - compliance. ---

steps.title: 10. Map profiles and permissions
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '10. Map profiles and permissions'.
steps.description: Required matrix: | Profile | Scope | Domain | Module | Feature | View | Create | Edit | Delete | Approve | Configure | Export | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider profiles such as: - platform super-admin; - tenant administrator; - company administrator; - HQ administrator; - branch administrator; - manager; - operator; - analyst; - finance; - support; - auditor; - end user; - customer; - guest; - read-only user. Adapt the profiles to the product context. ---

steps.title: 11. Map settings
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '11. Map settings'.
steps.description: Required table: | Setting level | Setting | Description | System impact | Who can change it | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider, when applicable: - global platform settings; - plan-level settings; - tenant-level settings; - company-level settings; - HQ-level settings; - branch-level settings; - feature flags; - usage limits; - email templates; - notification templates; - integrations; - permissions; - visual identity; - language; - currency; - timezone; - security policies. ---

steps.title: 12. Map high-level data
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '12. Map high-level data'.
steps.description: Required table: | Entity or object | Description | Main fields | Relationships | Domain | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Do not generate the final physical database model yet. Only identify the data needed to guide the next modeling stage. ---

steps.title: 13. Map candidate integrations
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '13. Map candidate integrations'.
steps.description: Required table: | Integration | Type | Goal | Data exchanged | Criticality | Priority | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested types: - API; - webhook; - authentication; - payment; - email; - WhatsApp; - SMS; - ERP; - CRM; - BI; - storage; - AI; - calendar; - maps; - documents; - e-signature. ---

steps.title: 14. Map automations and AI
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '14. Map automations and AI'.
steps.description: Required table: | Automation or AI | Description | Input | Processing | Output | Benefit | Risk | Priority | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider: - assistants; - recommendations; - classification; - summarization; - data extraction; - document generation; - predictive analysis; - smart alerts; - workflow automations; - automatic prioritization; - anomaly detection; - chatbots; - copilots; - smart audit. ---

steps.title: 15. Map reports and dashboards
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '15. Map reports and dashboards'.
steps.description: Required table: | Report or dashboard | Audience | Goal | Indicators | Filters | Usage frequency | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include: - executive dashboard; - operational dashboard; - analytics reports; - financial reports; - productivity reports; - audit; - platform usage; - tenant indicators; - company indicators; - branch indicators. ---

steps.title: 16. Map states, messages, and feedback
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '16. Map states, messages, and feedback'.
steps.description: Required table: | Context | State | Suggested message | Recommended action | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| Mandatory states: - loading; - empty; - error; - no permission; - success; - validation; - conflict; - offline; - plan limit reached; - session expired; - integration unavailable; - awaiting approval. ---

steps.title: 17. Define initial acceptance criteria
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '17. Define initial acceptance criteria'.
steps.description: Create criteria per main feature: | Feature | Acceptance criterion | Type | Notes | |---|---|---|---| Types: - functional; - permission; - validation; - UX; - security; - integration; - performance; - audit. ---

steps.title: 18. Consolidate scope by priority
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '18. Consolidate scope by priority'.
steps.description: Classify features as: - Essential; - Important; - Advanced; - Future; - Experimental; - Validation-dependent. Required table: | Item | Type | Domain | Module | Priority | Justification | Dependencies | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| ---

steps.title: 19. Apply UX/UI guidelines from the aesthetic file
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '19. Apply UX/UI guidelines from the aesthetic file'.
steps.description: Read: Extract the guidelines that affect: - Stage 4 dashboard structure; - visual organization of tables; - card style; - filter behavior; - information density; - document hierarchy; - responsiveness; - accessibility; - microcopy; - visual states; - component language; - interface tone. The visual section of Stage 4 must be a practical application of the official aesthetic, not a new visual direction. If the aesthetic file does not exist, state: ---

steps.title: 20. Generate recommendations for Stage 5
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '20. Generate recommendations for Stage 5'.
steps.description: Stage 4 should end by indicating how the next stage should use this specification. Recommend: - candidate entities for data modeling; - relationships that should be detailed; - rules that affect the data model; - permissions that affect the structure; - integrations that affect the architecture; - events that need audit; - features that need validation; - UX points that need more detail; - points that should become backlog; - risks that must be handled before development. ---

steps.title: 1. Header
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '1. Header'.
steps.description: Display: - product name; - stage name: `Stage 4 — Structured Functional Specification`; - files or inputs used; - aesthetic file used: `0-estetica-inicial.md`; - generated file; - generation date; - analyzed segment; - number of domains; - number of modules; - number of features; - number of screens; - number of rules; - number of profiles; - recommended next stage. The header must follow the product’s official visual direction. ---

steps.title: 2. Indicator Cards
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '2. Indicator Cards'.
steps.description: Create cards with: - total input documents analyzed; - total domains; - total modules; - total features; - total screens; - total business rules; - total profiles; - total integrations; - total automations and AI; - specification maturity level; - recommended next stage. ---

steps.title: 3. Tables and Matrices
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '3. Tables and Matrices'.
steps.description: Create tables for: - domains; - modules; - features; - screens; - actions and events; - business rules; - permission matrix; - settings; - high-level data; - integrations; - automations and AI; - reports and dashboards; - states and messages; - acceptance criteria; - prioritization; - dependencies; - risks; - recommendations. The tables must be readable, responsive, and aligned with the official aesthetic direction. ---

steps.title: 4. Detailed Analyses
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '4. Detailed Analyses'.
steps.description: Create expandable sections for: - executive summary; - consolidated context; - functional scope; - domain view; - module view; - rules and permissions; - UX/UI derived from the aesthetic; - gaps; - recommendations for Stage 5. These sections must use the language defined in the aesthetic file. ---

steps.title: 5. Sources and References
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '5. Sources and References'.
steps.description: Create a final section with: | ID | Type | Title | Origin | URL or document | Used in | Note | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include references to input documents and research sources from previous stages. ---
